header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: are engaged in declaring Your purity, greatness, praise and glory,’ they will say. Allah will ask, ‘Have they seen Me?’ They will reply, ‘By Allah! They have never seen You.’ Allah will ask, ‘What would their state be if they had seen Me?’ The angels will say, ‘If they had seen You, they would engage in Ibadah even more, and they would praise You and declare Your glory even more than this.’ Allah will ask, ‘What do they ask of Me?’ They will say, ‘They ask You for Jannah.’ He will ask, ‘Have they seen Jannah?’ The angels will say, ‘By Allah! O Rabb! They have not seen Jannah.’ Allah will inquire, ‘What would their state be if they had seen Jannah?’ The angels will say, ‘If they had seen it, they would be in even greater longing, eagerness and seeking for Jannah than this.’ Allah will ask, ‘From what do they seek protection?’ The angels will reply, ‘They seek protection from Jahannam.’ Allah will inquire, “Have they seen Jahannam?” The angels will say, ‘By Allah! O Rabb! They have not seen it.’ Allah will ask, ‘What would their state be if they had seen Jahannam?’ The angels will say, ‘If they had seen it, they would fear it even more and strive to escape from it.’ Allah will say, ‘Be witnesses that I have forgiven those who are in that gathering.’ ‘A man came there for some other need, not to do the Dhikr of Allah’ (and sat down
